jobs.occupation: PhD student for TIQTOC optical atomic clock experiment for Ultra-light Dark Matter (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
For our location in Zeuthen we are seeking:

PhD student for TIQTOC optical atomic clock experiment for Ultra-light Dark Matter

Remuneration Group E13 | Limited: 3 years | Starting date: 01.01.2027 | ID: APDO006/2026 | Deadline: open | Part-time

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The Zeuthen location of DESY has a strong focus on astroparticle and particle physics (gamma-ray and neutrino astronomy, and collider particle physics). The experimental groups are accompanied by a strong theory group. DESY Zeuthen is responsible for developing and delivering detectors for astroparticle and particle physics experiments, and is actively engaged in R&D for future applications.

With the Centre for Quantum Technology and Applications (CQTA), DESY Zeuthen is taking a leading role in applying quantum technology to challenges in particle and astroparticle physics. A new search for the effects of ultralight dark matter is being constructed, using ultra-sensitive optical atomic clocks as the sensing element. The post holder will contribute to this search, developing a test setup for networked clock comparison and frequency stabilisation. The post holder will also help to develop the procedures to collect and analyse the frequency comparisons, forming the basis of fundamental physics searches for (e.g.) ultralight dark matter.

About your role:

- Active role in developing test infrastructure for optical atomic clocks and comparison to reference clocks
- Develop instrumentation for measuring fundamental constants
- Participate in building up clock-based experiments at Humboldt University, DESY, Heidelberg or U. Birmingham
- Analyse experimental atomic clock data and participate in the interpretation of results

About you:

- Experience in one of the relevant physics fields (e.g. particle, atomic/nuclear physics, quantum optics) with Master's degree or equivalent
- Experience with detector physics, with good computer programming skills
- Very good command of English is required and knowledge of German is of advantage
- Willingness to travel and participate in working meetings, conferences, and field work abroad (e.g. at MPIK Heidelberg)
- Strong motivation, very good organizational skills, resilience; ability to work in teams and excellent communication skills

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work life balance we offer flexible working hours and variable part-time. You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the

TV-AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

For further information please contact Prof. Steven Worm at +49 33762-7-7208 [(steven.worm@desy.de).](https://mailto:(steven.worm@desy.de)

DESY in Zeuthen does not grant doctoral degrees directly but collaborates with the University of Potsdam or the Humboldt University. Candidates for thesis research will have to satisfy the terms of admission for doctoral theses of the University. PhD students receive a monthly salary of 67% of the payment of the remuneration group 13 TVöD (Federal Government).

Please submit your complete application documents (letter of motivation, CV, relevant certificates and two letters of references) via our application portal. jobs.description:
Snapshot of your Day

As a Data Analyst (f/m/d), you will support the Process Digitalization Team for Grid Technologies within Siemens Energy. Working closely with more than 30 factories across our global Manufacturing Network, you will contribute to the development and adoption of our secure, centrally governed, and AI-enabled Data Mesh.

Your focus will be on transforming scalable data into actionable insights, enabling data-driven decision-making and sustainable business growth. By analyzing complex datasets and translating business requirements into analytical solutions, you will drive cross-functional data and analytics initiatives that enhance competitiveness and support the future development of our products and processes. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 
* Conducting in-depth analyses of manufacturing and operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process improvement across the business area
* Supporting the definition, development, and continuous refinement of data structures and data products, with a focus on data quality, consistency, and usability
* Collaboration with data engineering and cloud architecture teams to ensure analytical requirements are reflected in data ingestion processes, data models, and platform capabilities
* Development and maintenance of dashboards, KPIs, reports, and lightweight analytical applications to increase transparency and support data-driven decision-making
* Continuous evaluation and optimization of analytical workflows, performance metrics, and reporting processes to enhance operational efficiency and business value creation
* Provision of actionable insights and analytical recommendations to support strategic initiatives, operational excellence, and the adoption of data-driven practices across the organization

What You Bring
* Academic degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable field, combined with professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or data-driven process optimization
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including hands-on experience with modern data and analytics tools such as Snowflake, dbt Cloud, Alteryx, Python, and SQL
* Expertise in the development of dashboards, KPI frameworks, reporting solutions, and data visualizations using leading business intelligence platforms such as Power BI and Tableau
* Solid understanding of cloud-based data ecosystems, preferably Snowflake and AWS, as well as modern data stack concepts including ELT processes and data modeling
* Ability to transform complex datasets into clear insights, actionable recommendations, and decision-relevant information for stakeholders across all organizational levels
* Business fluency in English, strong communication and stakeholder management skills, an international mindset and willingness to travel internationally

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

How to contribute to our vision

This role is being created as a new addition to ensure business continuity and provide on-site construction management for new office and industrial build projects in Berlin (DE), as approved by executive leadership. The position is situated within the SE Real Estate's Project Management BSS PM1 team, directly supporting strategic growth initiatives. To successfully deliver these new facilities, the role will focus on three primary areas: hands-on project execution and site management, strategic project planning and risk mitigation, and comprehensive stakeholder communication and coordination. This structure ensures end-to-end control from initial planning through to final delivery, aligning with Siemens Energy's standards. Given the focus on complex office and industrial builds, the ideal candidate will possess specialized expertise in construction management, backed by an advanced degree in a relevant engineering or architectural field. Proven experience in managing large projects, strong stakeholder communication, and a proactive approach to problem-solving are essential for success.

What You Need To Make a Difference

* 50% On-Site Construction Management & Execution
+ Lead and manage all on-site activities for major industrial construction projects, ensuring alignment with project timelines and budgets.
+ Oversee contractors and execution teams to guarantee compliance with Siemens Energy's quality standards, sustainability guidelines, and safety protocols.
+ Monitor project progress, conduct site inspections, and resolve any on-site issues to maintain project momentum and quality.
+ Ensure all construction activities adhere to local German legal and operational requirements.
* 30% Project Planning, Strategy & Risk Management
+ Proactively identify, assess, and manage project risks (financial, schedule, quality) to prevent delays and cost overruns.
+ Develop and maintain detailed project documentation, including schedules, budgets, and progress reports.
+ Support sustainability initiatives by integrating energy efficiency measures and pursuing green building certifications.
* 20% Stakeholder Management & Digitalization
+ Serve as the primary point of contact and facilitate collaboration between internal teams, external consultants, contractors, and local authorities.
+ Manage communication with all project stakeholders, providing regular updates and ensuring alignment on project goals and milestones.

Certifications

* Project Management Professional (PMP)

* 3-5 years of professional experience managing construction projects for industrial facilities, preferably in an international context.

+ Risk Management

* Management & Communication

- In-depth experience in software design, testing methods and programming skills, ideally in Python and/or Robot Framework.
- Knowledge of relevant functional safety standards (e.g. IEC 61508) and security standards (e.g. IEC 62443-4-X).

- Understanding of hardware-level testing and interfaces between software and hardware.
- Ability to work in interdisciplinary teams and to communicate technical content clearly and precisely.
- A structured and independent approach to work, with a focus on meeting deadlines and achieving objectives.

The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

The Department Pediatric Neurooncology is looking, starting from 01.11.2026, for a Strategic Officer.

The department led by Prof. Stefan Pfister at the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) and the Hopp Children’s Cancer Center Heidelberg (KiTZ) combines international pediatric oncology research with data-driven precision oncology and the development of sustainable research infrastructures.

A key international initiative of the department is the ITCC PedCanPortal, a data and research platform developed in collaboration with leading European partners in pediatric oncology. The project aims to bring together a large, international multi-omics dataset comprising molecular and clinical data from more than 5,000 patients and to make these high-quality research data, along with analytical tools, accessible and sustainably available to the international research community. In doing so, the ITCC PedCanPortal aims to support the development of new diagnostic and therapeutic approaches for children and adolescents with cancer.

The Strategic Officer will work at the interface of science, strategy, international partnerships, and the sustainable development of the ITCC PedCanPortal, with a particular focus on establishing the organizational and financial structures required for its long-term sustainability.

Your Tasks

As Strategy Officer, you will be embedded within the central coordination structure of ITCC PedCanPortal and work closely with the project leadership, international consortium partners, patient representatives, advisory bodies, and external stakeholders.

Your primary responsibility will be to develop, coordinate, and implement a comprehensive long-term continuity and implementation strategy for ITCC PedCanPortal beyond its current funding period (e.g., via a non-profit spin-off). Sustainability planning will be treated as a continuous and evolving process, closely aligned with the scientific, technical, ethical, and operational development of the platform.

Key responsibilities:

Strategic development and sustainability planning

- Develop and continuously refine a long-term continuity and implementation strategy for ITCC PedCanPortal
- Design governance and operational models for the future operation and expansion of the platform
- Evaluate and develop sustainable funding and partnership models
- Support the onboarding of future programs, projects, and stakeholders into the ITCC PedCanPortal ecosystem

Stakeholder management and international coordination

- Coordinate continuity-related activities across a large international consortium
- Facilitate interactions with academic partners, patient representatives, external stakeholders, and industry collaborators
- Support strategic discussions within governance and advisory structures
- Build and maintain strong relationships across the international pediatric oncology community

Governance, reporting, and implementation

- Ensure alignment of continuity planning with scientific, ethical, legal, and operational requirements
- Prepare strategic reports, recommendations, and implementation concepts for project leadership and governance bodies
- Contribute to annual reporting, risk assessment, and long-term planning activities
- Support the translation of strategic concepts into operational implementation plans

Your Profile

We are looking for a highly organized and strategically minded individual who enjoys working at the intersection of science, innovation and international collaboration.

Essential:

- PhD or 5+ years experience in life sciences, medicine, public health, health economics, management, law or a related discipline.
- Experience in scientific program management, research strategy, innovation management, business development or international collaborative projects.
- Excellent organizational and communication skills.
- Experience working with diverse stakeholder groups in complex international environments.
- Excellent written and spoken English.

Desirable:

- Experience with large-scale research infrastructures, data platforms or precision medicine initiatives.
- Understanding of governance, continuity planning and funding strategies.
- Experience in public-private partnerships, translational research or health innovation.
- Familiarity with biomedical research, pediatric oncology, genomics or health data ecosystems.

You can look forward to:

- The opportunity to help shape one of the world's leading pediatric cancer data platforms.
- A highly international and interdisciplinary working environment.
- Close interaction with internationally renowned experts in pediatric oncology, genomics, data science, ethics and patient advocacy.
- A unique strategic role with significant visibility and impact.
- Excellent opportunities for professional and personal development.
- Flexible working arrangements within a dynamic research environment.
- Join us in building the future of pediatric precision oncology and creating a sustainable international data infrastructure that will improve outcomes for children with cancer worldwide.

We Offer

- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level
- 30 days of vacation per year
- Flexible working hours
- Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments
- Possibility of mobile work and part-time work
- Family-friendly working environment
- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket
- Unleash your full potential: targeted offers for your personal development to further develop your talents
- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-being

Are you interested?

Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!

We welcome applications via our website from 25 August - 07 October 2026.

The International Max Planck Research School for Molecules of Life (IMPRS-ML) offers fully funded PhD student positions in the areas of biochemistry, structural biology, biophysics, cell biology, systems biology, and computational biology. We are looking for outstanding graduates from all over the world to join our network of passionate young scientists in Munich. CURRICULUM & TRAINING

In this role, you will join the Multi-Tenant Platforms team: We own, build, and harden, the internal SAP Sovereign Cloud environments used as reference by the regional Operations teams. You will help deliver SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) applications to SAP Sovereign Cloud customers aiming at functional completeness, streamlined deployments, and smooth operation.

You will be working closely with technical product managers, engineers, our security team, as well as SAP product team members, and operations teams. You will have the opportunity to solve the intricate Sovereign Cloud challenges of scale and security, while using your skills to deploy applications.

You will be the subject matter expert of the Sovereign Cloud BDC environment setup, leveraging your functional & technical expertise, complexity analysis, and stakeholder management. You will engage closely with regional Operations colleagues, Security, QA, as well as the other Sovereign Cloud Engineering teams. You will drive the end-to-end deployment of product capabilities - from defining implementation concepts, to performing functional & technical assessments, hardening, ultimately culminating in automated deployments for customer adoption.

WHAT YOU BRING

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or similar field
- Professional experience in Cloud Delivery related fields and technologies
- In-depth knowledge of hyperscalers like AWS required
- In-depth experience in technologies used for deploying and managing Cloud-native applications:
- Container Orchestration tools e.g. Gardener (preferred), Kubernetes, Docker
- Helm charts
- Repository management e.g. Artifactory (preferred), JFrog (preferred)
- Service management tools e.g. Consul (preferred), Zookeeper
- API Management tools e.g. Apigee (preferred)
- Understanding of deployment automation and the tools e.g. Ansible, Chef
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code - Terraform preferred
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines e.g. ArgoCD (preferred), GitLab CI/CD (preferred), Jenkins
- Experience with Monitoring e.g. Dynat , CloudWatch
- Experience with Logging e.g. Splunk (preferred), Elasticsearch, Logstash
- Experience with Cloud Networking tools e.g. AWS VPCs (preferred), VNet
- Familiarity with GitLab and/or GitHub
- Scripting background e.g. PowerShell, Python (preferred)
- Security best practices including hardened containers and images (STIG)
- Experience with Security tools e.g. Hashicorp Vault (preferred), GitHub Secrets
- Database knowledge like SAP HANA
- Expertise with OS e.g. Linux, RHEL
- Excellent oral and written communication skills in English
- Familiarity with Cloud Foundry is a plus
- Prior exposure to OpenStack deployment or CLI tools is a plus
- Knowledge of SAP and the SAP solution portfolio is a plus

WORK EXPERIENCE

- 7+ years of professional experience in Cloud Delivery related fields and technologies
- 4+ years of experience in cloud operations - developing, delivering and maintaining Cloud Products
- Development experience in at least one programming language
- Professional experience in software engineering roles

We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

Role Overview

The Solution Sales Executive (SSE) / Account Executive Specialist (f/m/d) is a strategic leader who combines deep SAP expertise, business acumen, and end-to-end solution area domain knowledge to drive LoB cloud revenue, customer success, accelerate adoption of innovation (especially AI), and position the organization as a market leader. Within the Finance & Spend Management LoB, you will be working in one of our three sales teams with a primary focus on Procurement, and be responsible for our portfolio including SAP Ariba and SAP Fieldglass. The SSE shapes transformative solutions and delivers measurable value to customers through thought leadership, innovation, and strategic execution—supporting both specific Lines of Business (LoB) and the overall “One SAP” strategy.

Key Responsibilities include

- Lead Efforts: Establish, develop, and expand market share for SAP’s Spend - Procurement solutions within named accounts in Germany
- Pipeline & Opportunity Management: Build and execute a strong pipeline for Spend to achieve the quarterly and yearly sales target.
- Account Ownership & Strategy: Serve as the LoB owner for assigned accounts, developing and executing strategic account plans that align with customer goals, business objectives and broader account plans by account team.
- Drive End-to-End Customer Value Journey with Domain Expertise: Provide solution area domain expertise and thought leadership to understand and address high-priority business challenges. Lead end-to-end process mapping and the customer value journey, owning the transformation roadmap for the LoB.
- Enablement, Demos & Prototypes: Support solution advisors to ensure demo system readiness and manage enablement programs. Collaborate with Demo & Learning teams to provide updated assets and trial environments as part of scalable enablement programs as well as customized demos, POCs and prototypes with customer specific data.
- Value Proposition & Executive Engagement: Collaborate with value advisors to create compelling narratives articulating ROI, value leakage and competitive advantages. Conduct strategic discovery, run value leakage, AOTP workshops and deliver persuasive pitches with ways of solving distinct customer business/buying-center challenges to accelerate executive buy-in and drive demand independently of RFPs.
- Commercial Negotiations: Navigate complex pricing and contractual discussions, balancing client expectations with organizational profitability and cloud revenue growth.
- Adoption & Consumption: Support Customer Success Management (CSM) communities, secure references, and manage escalations. Collaborate with CS and CS&D adoption teams to ensure successful delivery of solutions and services, monitoring outcomes and driving continuous improvement to maximize customer value.
- Customer Success & Field Impact: Own LoB deal cycles, renewals, enablement, and executive engagement. Elevate customer discussions to prioritize investment and drive measurable outcomes.
- Relationship Building & Governance: Drive C-suite engagements and Buying Center Alignment by fostering long-term high-value relationships and convert executives into advocates and brand ambassadors. Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with customers and internal stakeholders focused on solution adoption, innovation, risks and opportunities.
- Ecosystem & Partner Engagement: Own relationships with strategic consulting partners (e.g., McKinsey, Bain, Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, EY) to co-innovate, develop joint go-to-market strategies, and shape disruptive solutions. Maintain direct, high-quality relationships with partner account leads.
- Collaboration & Orchestration: Align closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing to ensure SAL impact is fully integrated into the go-to-market engine with tailored GTM approach. Drive joint accountability and coordination across internal stakeholders for maximum market impact.
- Competitive & Industry Expertise: Maintain deep technical and functional knowledge across SAP solutions. Stay at the forefront of emerging technologies and competitive trends to craft differentiated solutions that win in the market.

- 
7+ years of professional sales experience, with SAP Spend solutions (Beneficial: Procurement, Sourcing/Contracts, Finance/AP, ERP, Business Technology Platform or Workforce Management), SaaS solutions, VMS or Procurement

- 
Relationships in procurement and finance communities (e.g. CIOs, CPOs, CFOs, procurement/finance directors, Head of Direct or Indirect Proc. etc.) of advantage

- 
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Information Technology, or related field.

- 
B2B enterprise experience with multi-stakeholder SaaS cycles, plus top-tier consulting and deep industry expertise.

- 
Strong understanding of solution sales, customer value realization, and account planning methodologies; Expansion selling track record (account growth).

- 
Deep SAP and domain expertise, with strong understanding of AI and innovation trends.

- 
Maps value levers and tell a quantified ROI storytelling and compelling business case creation

- 
Strategic thinking, business acumen, relationship building and client advocacy skills.

- 
Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management abilities.

- 
Ability to work collaboratively in a matrixed environment and influence without direct authority.

- 
Analytical mindset with a focus on problem-solving and continuous improvement.

- 
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in German (min. C1 level) and English

Join HIMA Group – Innovate with purpose. Grow with technology.

HIMA Group is a globally independent provider of safety-related automation solutions for the process and rail industries, protecting people, assets, and the environment. Founded in 1908, the family-owned company is headquartered in Brühl near Mannheim, Germany, and has grown steadily through strategic acquisitions, including Sella Controls (UK) in 2023 and Origo Solutions (Norway) in 2024. Today, HIMA employs approximately 1,100 professionals across 22 group companies worldwide.

Our international teams bring together expertise from all corners of the world, working with a shared focus on developing reliable and sustainable solutions. At HIMA, employees are encouraged to take initiative, contribute their knowledge, and collaborate across borders to deliver projects with real impact.

Working at HIMA offers varied and responsible tasks, where your work has tangible influence. At the same time, you can continuously develop your skills and contribute to advancing safety technology. With a corporate culture built on collaboration, accountability, and sustainable innovation, we provide a professional environment where experts can thrive and make meaningful contributions.

Become part of a global success story and help shape the future of digital safety.

Position Summary

The Sr Specialist Compliance (m/f/d) ensures compliance with global material and environmental regulations such as REACH, RoHS, and TSCA. The role manages compliance processes, maintains material data and documentation, and supports regulatory reporting. Working closely with suppliers and internal stakeholders, the position identifies compliance risks and drives mitigation actions. It acts as a key interface for regulatory, customer, and sustainability-related requirements.

Responsibilities 

- Monitoring, assessment, and practical interpretation of international regulations and standards (e.g. REACH, RoHS, TSCA, Proposition 65).
- Establishment, maintenance, and continuous improvement of a Material Compliance Management System, including related processes and workflows.
- Collection, validation, and archiving of material data (material declarations, analysis certificates, SDS, etc.).
- Preparation of compliance reports and product declarations for internal stakeholders and customers.
- Support and coordination of supplier management activities, including supplier inquiries, evaluation of incoming data, and follow-up on missing information.
- Cross-functional collaboration with Procurement, R&D, Product Management, and other departments to implement compliance requirements.
- Identification of compliance risks arising from new regulatory requirements or non-compliant materials, and development of concrete mitigation and action plans.
- Communication with authorities, customers, and testing bodies; handling of customer inquiries related to material compliance.
- Contribution to the maintenance of sustainability and compliance platforms (e.g. EcoVadis) and preparation for external audits and assessments.

Qualifications

- Several years of professional experience in Material Compliance, Regulatory Affairs, or related functions are strongly recommended.
- Technical education in materials science, environmental engineering, technical chemistry, or a comparable field.
- Strong ability to analyze regulatory texts and legislation and to correctly translate requirements into product-specific contexts.
- Experience in handling material data and documentation systems; structured working style and strong quality orientation.
- Excellent communication skills (internal and external) and experience in working with suppliers and authorities.
- Independent working style, confident professional demeanor, and the ability to represent compliance requirements internally with the necessary level of assertiveness.
- Very good German and good English skills, both written and spoken.

Preferred Qualifications

- Environmental auditor qualification or comparable certification.
- Experience with material databases and EHS modules.
- Experience with sustainability or supply chain platforms (e.g. EcoVadis, IMDS, or similar).
- Knowledge of risk analysis and CAPA management.

Diversity, equality, and inclusion are an integral part of our corporate culture. We welcome applications from all candidates, regardless of gender, age, disability, religion, ethnic origin, or sexual identity.
